description: This file defines a dialog for accessibility help in CKEditor, including key mappings, help content generation, and dialog configuration.

methods.name: representKeyStroke
methods.description: Converts a keystroke code into a human-readable string with modifiers.

methods.name: replaceVariables
methods.description: Replaces variable placeholders in help content with actual keystroke representations.

methods.name: buildHelpContents
methods.description: Builds the HTML content for the accessibility help dialog based on language data.
